summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Super Admin panel pages. All 7 sidebar navigation links work (Dashboard, Tenants, Users, Subscriptions, Analytics, Activity, Settings). Tenant CRUD operations work correctly. Users page shows 6 users with super admin badges, search filtering, and action dropdowns. One issue found: Platform Settings save fails silently due to FK constraint on store_settings.tenant_id.

integration_issues.issue: Settings form submits but changes don't persist after reload. The updatePlatformSettings action uses a reserved tenant_id '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' which likely violates FK constraint on store_settings table. Error is not displayed to user.

action_items: Fix Platform Settings save: Either (1) create a platform tenant row with id '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' in tenants table, OR (2) remove FK constraint on store_settings.tenant_id, OR (3) use a different storage mechanism for platform settings
Add error handling in Settings page to display save errors to user
critical_code_review_comments: platform-settings.ts: updatePlatformSettings returns {error: message} but Settings page doesn't handle/display it
Settings page uses server action form but doesn't show success/error feedback to user
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted test tenant 'Acme Store' during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Super Admin panel pages all load correctly. Main issue is Platform Settings save not persisting due to FK constraint. All other CRUD operations (tenants, users) work correctly. Use page.type() instead of page.fill() for React controlled inputs.
